title: microsorum superficiale var. australiense

It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Microsorum superficiale var. australiense have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
